newsitem.title: REPUBLIC OF IRELAND: Dana Petroleum half-yr pretax loss narrows.
newsitem.headline: Dana Petroleum half-yr pretax loss narrows.

text.p: Exploration company Dana Petroleum said on Friday it had made a pre-tax loss of 0.326 million stg in the first half of 1996, versus a loss of 0.558 million in the same period the previous year.
The retained deficit carried forward was 1.519 million stg versus 1.048 million.
Dana also announced it was making a bid for Irish exploration firm Petroceltic, offering nine Dana shares for every four Petroceltic shares to value Petroceltic at 3.05 million punts.
Dana said its market capitalisation was around 64 million stg, versus 18 million at the end of 1995.
